description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1905/20 of 11.03.2015 & other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically addresses amendments to land parcel registrations (Parcel No. 33 and No. 36 of Block 05) in Rathnapura District, including the expunging of particulars from previous gazette publications. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and involves land title settlement procedures, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
